result.rationale: The finding claims `teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar)` pushes null entries, but the diff explicitly guards it: `if (isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE" && user.destinationCalendar) { teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar); }` — a user with no destinationCalendar is never pushed, so no null entries can enter the array. The described mechanism (null becoming element 0 and crashing `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration`) therefore cannot arise from the code shown.

judged_text: `teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar)` pushes null entries when a collective host has no destinationCalendar, and the array is later spread into evt.destinationCalendar. A null entry can become element 0 of evt.destinationCalendar (e.g. organizer has none so the base is null... skipped, or is ordered first via users.slice), at which point `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = ...` yields null and `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` in EventManager crashes the same way as the undefined case.

record.issue_text: [ADVISORY] `teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar)` pushes null entries when a collective host has no destinationCalendar, and the array is later spread into evt.destinationCalendar. A null entry can become element 0 of evt.destinationCalendar (e.g. organizer has none so the base is null... skipped, or is ordered first via users.slice), at which point `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = ...` yields null and `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` in EventManager crashes the same way as the undefined case.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, the code only pushes when `user.destinationCalendar` is truthy: `if (... && user.destinationCalendar) { teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar); }`, so it cannot push `null` entries. Also, later `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` uses optional chaining, so if `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null` it will not push/spread at all—meaning a `null` element cannot become index 0 via this path. (Separately, there may be a real crash risk in `EventManager` because `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` can yield `undefined` for an empty array and then `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` would throw, but that is not what this finding asserts.)
